description: Sector-specific ransomware metrics for critical manufacturing, including IBM X-Force, NCC Group, Sophos, and FBI IC3 data.
FBI IC3 sector-level ransomware incident counts for U.S. critical infrastructure (Healthcare, Manufacturing, Energy, Transportation, Water, Financial Services).
Metrics on major, well-known cyber campaigns like MOVEit (Clop) and LockBit 3.0.
Specific metrics on Wizard Spider campaigns (Conti, Ryuk).
Specific metrics on Gold Southfield campaigns (REvil/Sodinokibi).
Data on common initial access vectors for ransomware from various CTI reports.
Specific metrics on Iranian threat actor campaigns and targeting.
